shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && printf '\\n-- files --\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | head -200 && printf '\\n-- skill --\\n' && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,140p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n-- package.json --\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n-- app --\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' src/App.tsx && printf '\\n-- main --\\n' && sed -n '1,120p' src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"date-components\" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && npm install --save @gravity-ui/date-components @gravity-ui/date-utils && node -e \"for (const p of ['@gravity-ui/date-components','@gravity-ui/date-utils']) { const pkg=require(p+'/package.json'); console.log(p, pkg.version, JSON.stringify(pkg.peerDependencies||{})); }\" && printf '\\n-- exports --\\n' && rg -n \"export|Calendar\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/index.d.ts | head -100"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@4 version peerDependencies --json | tail -60'

/bin/bash -lc 'npm install --save @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@''^2.6.0 && node -e "for (const p of ['"'@gravity-ui/date-components','@gravity-ui/date-utils']) { const pkg=require(p+'/package.json'); console.log(p, pkg.version); }\" && printf '\\n-- docs/type files --\\n' && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components -maxdepth 3 \\( -iname 'README*' -o -iname 'INDEX.md' -o -name '*.d.ts' \\) | head -50 && printf '\\n-- exports --\\n' && rg -n \"declare const|export \\{\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/index.d.ts | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/INDEX.md && printf '\\n-- types --\\n' && sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/index.d.ts && printf '\\n-- calendar type refs --\\n' && rg -n \"type CalendarProps|declare const Calendar|interface CalendarProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '-- Calendar doc --' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/components/Calendar.md && printf '%s\\n' '-- Calendar props --' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts && printf '%s\\n' '-- common types --' && rg -n \"type CalendarValueType|type SelectionMode|interface CalendarCommonProps|type CalendarViewType|type CalendarSize|type CalendarDaysOfWeek\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm -g '*.d.ts'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,170p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/types.d.ts && printf '\\n-- docs value section --\\n' && rg -n -A 12 -B 4 \"onUpdate|onChange\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/components/Calendar.md | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,70p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/types/index.d.ts && printf '\\n-- InputBase --\\n' && rg -n -A 30 \"interface InputBase|type InputBase\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/types -g '*.d.ts' | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/types/events.d.ts && printf '\\n-- RangeValue --\\n' && rg -n -A 8 \"type RangeValue|interface RangeValue\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/types -g '*.d.ts'"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/types/inputs.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'command -v perl node busybox patch git || true && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"type BoxProps|interface BoxProps|display|direction|gap\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/types/Box/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -100 || true; rg -n \"import \\{.*Box|BoxProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -g '*.d.ts' | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts && printf '\\n-- export refs --\\n' && rg -n \"export .*Flex|export .*Box\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export .*Flex|declare const Flex|from './layout|from './components/layout\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30 && rg -n \"export .*Flex\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g 'index.d.ts' | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -40 && rg -n \"\\{Flex|\\bFlex\\b\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.js | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -30 && rg -n \"export \\{.*Flex|as Flex\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.js | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | rg "layout|Flex|Box"'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"addLanguageKeysets|lang=\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/*.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md 2>/dev/null | head -30 || true && rg -n \"ru|lang\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.d.ts | head -30 && node -e \"console.log(require.resolve('@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json'))\""

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -30 && rg -n \"interface ThemeProviderProps|type ThemeProviderProps|lang\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ThemeProvider -g '*.d.ts' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"ThemeProvider\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g 'index.d.ts' | head -20 && rg -n \"interface ThemeProviderProps|lang\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | rg \"Theme|lang\" | head -40"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,80p' src/main.tsx && printf '\\n-- App --\\n' && sed -n '1,100p' src/App.tsx && printf '\\n-- deps --\\n' && cat package.json | sed -n '1,45p'"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"Calendar|selectedDate|Выбранная\" src/App.tsx && rg -n \"loadLocale|lang=\\\"ru\\\"\" src/main.tsx"
